project("SonicGenerationsRecompLib")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Static library containing the recompiled game code (ppc/).
#
# The sources in ppc/ are generated by XenonRecomp from default.xex (see
# config.toml at the repository root). To regenerate them:
#
#     cmake --build <build-dir> --target recomp
#
# with your decrypted default.xex placed next to config.toml. The custom
# target is only registered when tools/XenonRecomp is available (it always
# is as a submodule) and requires the XEX to exist at build time.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set(SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_DIR "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}/ppc")

file(GLOB SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_DIR}/ppc_recomp.*.cpp")

list(APPEND SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_SOURCES
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_DIR}/ppc_func_mapping.cpp")

add_library(SonicGenerationsRecompLib STATIC ${SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(SonicGenerationsRecompLib PUBLIC
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}"
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

target_include_directories(SonicGenerationsRecompLib PRIVATE
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_TOOLS_ROOT}/XenonRecomp/thirdparty/simde")

# ppc_compat.h first: provides GCC shims used by the generated headers.
target_precompile_headers(SonicGenerationsRecompLib PRIVATE
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}/SonicGenerationsRecomp/ppc_compat.h"
    "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_DIR}/ppc_recomp_shared.h")

if (MSVC)
    target_compile_options(SonicGenerationsRecompLib PRIVATE /fp:strict)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    # Clang-only option; GCC uses the default FP model.
    target_compile_options(SonicGenerationsRecompLib PRIVATE -ffp-model=strict)
endif()

# Optional regeneration of ppc/ from the game's default.xex.
add_custom_target(recomp
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:XenonRecomp> "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}/config.toml" "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_PPC_DIR}/ppc_context.h"
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:XenonAnalyse> "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}/default.xex" "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}/switch_tables.toml"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${SONIC_GENERATIONS_RECOMP_ROOT}"
    COMMENT "Recompiling default.xex to C++ (XenonAnalyse + XenonRecomp)"
    USES_TERMINAL)

# Shader cache seam: SonicGenerationsRecompLib/shader/shader_cache.cpp is
# produced by tools/XenosRecomp once the shaders are recompiled. It is
# compiled as part of the runtime once it exists (see docs/ROADMAP.md).
